stories.title: Mercedes Moné addresses potential dream match vs. Bayley and happiness in AEW
stories.tldr: Mercedes Mone recently discussed her creative freedom and happiness on the AEW roster while preparing for major events like All In at Wembley Stadium. During a recent interview, she also addressed the possibility of facing her longtime friend and rival Bayley in a future dream match. While Bayley is currently under a WWE contract that has sparked departure speculation, industry experts note that WWE continues to mention her on television, suggesting they expect her to return. Regardless of future contract statuses, Mone made it clear that sharing the ring with Bayley again remains a high priority on her wish list.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland mourns the loss of his original pro wrestling trainer
stories.tldr: AEW star Swerve Strickland is mourning the passing of his original pro wrestling trainer, Ron The Pharaoh Cromartie. Cromartie was a prominent wrestler, promoter, and trainer on the Virginia independent scene who helped launch Strickland's career at the Ground Xero Wrestling Academy. Tributes have poured in from Strickland and local promotions recognizing Cromartie's legacy following his death. Meanwhile, Strickland is currently preparing for upcoming matches in AEW as he sets his sights on the Trios division.

stories.title: Karl Anderson says AJ Styles could 100% return to wrestling in AEW or elsewhere
stories.tldr: Former WWE star AJ Styles retired from in-ring competition in January 2026 and currently works in non-wrestling roles at NXT and the WWE Performance Center. In a recent interview, his longtime friend and Good Brothers tag team partner Karl Anderson expressed surprise at the retirement, noting that Styles can still perform at an elite level. Anderson stated that Styles could one day come out of retirement to wrestle in AEW or another promotion, pointing out his exceptional physical shape. While Styles himself previously left the door open for one special match, his actual return to the ring remains uncertain.

stories.title: Adam Copeland credits AEW for keeping him from retiring
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland recently revealed that he would be retired today if All Elite Wrestling did not exist, noting that his WWE career had reached its natural conclusion. After consulting his daughters and Tony Khan, Copeland made the jump to AEW in October 2023 to have fun, work with fresh talent, and reunite with Christian Cage. He credits the promotion with breathing new life into his career and providing exciting creative opportunities that keep his passion for wrestling alive.

stories.title: AEW champion addresses girlfriend's wrestling future following free agency
stories.tldr: AEW TNT Champion Kevin Knight recently addressed the wrestling future of his real-life girlfriend, Mara Sadè, who became a free agent following her departure from TNA Wrestling in August. While keeping mum on whether she is headed to AEW, Knight praised her relentless work ethic and rapid improvement since her time in NXT. He also noted how their contrasting training backgrounds, from the New Japan Dojo to the WWE Performance Center, have allowed them to continuously share knowledge and sharpen each other's skills.

stories.title: Daniel Garcia wins at ROH Death Before Dishonor to enter AEW Continental Cup, replacing injured Eddie Kingston
stories.tldr: Eddie Kingston has been pulled from the AEW Continental Challenge Cup after failing to receive medical clearance for his quarterfinal match. To fill the vacancy, Daniel Garcia defeated Adam Priest in a play-in match at ROH Death Before Dishonor. Garcia now advances to face his Death Riders stablemate Claudio Castagnoli on the upcoming episode of AEW Collision.

stories.title: Action Andretti joins stable and wins ROH World TV Title at Death Before Dishonor
stories.tldr: Action Andretti captured the ROH World Television Championship at Death Before Dishonor by defeating Lio Rush in a brutal Fight Without Honor match. During the chaotic bout, Andretti aligned with The Opps as HOOK and Anthony Bowens interfered to secure the title change. Following the match, a defeated Rush drank a mysterious black liquid from a heart-shaped container.

stories.title: David Arquette expresses interest in returning to wrestling with AEW
stories.tldr: David Arquette recently discussed his desire to produce a sequel to his 2000 wrestling comedy Ready to Rumble during a Reddit AMA. While financing remains a hurdle due to the original film's poor box office performance, the actor also revealed an interest in stepping back into the squared circle with AEW. Arquette specifically named Jeff Jarrett, Jack Perry, RJ City, and Dalton Castle as talent he would like to work with if an opportunity arises.

stories.title: Dax Harwood praises The Young Bucks and Mark Davis' future potential
stories.tldr: Dax Harwood recently praised The Young Bucks as potentially the greatest tag team of all time while discussing FTR's storied rivalry and legacy. Expanding on his recent media appearances, Harwood also reflected on his 2022 match against Aussie Open, correctly predicting that Mark Davis would eventually connect massively with fans despite Kyle Fletcher getting initial attention. Furthermore, Harwood labeled Davis one of the most underrated performers in the world and stated he would book him as a World Champion if he ran his own promotion.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor post-show media scrum and event notes
stories.tldr: Following the recent pay-per-view event, Ring of Honor hosted its post-show media scrum to address the night's developments. At the same time, critical analysis has highlighted ongoing questions regarding the brand's identity and long-term direction under Tony Khan. Observers continue to debate whether the promotion functions as a true developmental territory or merely a content mill for AEW.

stories.title: Road Dogg responds to claims political beliefs kept him out of AEW
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer has responded to recent claims that political beliefs cost a wrestling veteran a job with All Elite Wrestling. Meltzer pushed back on the allegation, stating that numerous employees within the company hold conservative viewpoints and that hiring decisions are never based on politics. The public back and forth originally stemmed from a disagreement over whether the promotion's tag team titles were beneath certain wrestlers.

stories.title: Athena retains Women's World Title against Hazuki at ROH Death Before Dishonor
stories.tldr: Athena successfully defended her ROH Women's World Championship against STARDOM star Hazuki in the main event of Death Before Dishonor. Despite outside interference from Billie Starkz and Diamante on behalf of the champion, Hazuki fought them off before ultimately falling to Athena's signature O-Face. This marks the historic titleholder's 38th successful defense of the belt she has held since December 2022.

stories.title: Lethal Twist wins ROH Six-Man Tag Team Titles at Death Before Dishonor
stories.tldr: Following earlier card adjustments, Death Before Dishonor continued with high-stakes championship action. In the opening match, Lethal Twist defeated Dalton Castle and The Outrunners to capture the ROH Six-Man Tag Team Titles. The victory ends the previous champions' 97-day reign and marks Jay Lethal's fifth distinct championship held within the promotion.

stories.title: Kevin Knight discusses AEW heel turn and free agency
stories.tldr: Following his shocking heel turn and pyro attack on Darby Allin, Kevin Knight is embracing his new persona as he prepares to face Allin at AEW All In: London. In a recent interview, Knight discussed how the heel run lets him finally showcase his authentic personality after years of suppressing it in structured systems like the New Japan dojo. He also named Jeff Hardy, The Rock, and Mr. Perfect as his childhood inspirations, and addressed the free agency of his partner, former TNA wrestler Mara Sadè.

stories.title: The Fight Game Podcast: Kenny Omega vs. Will Ospreay feud heats up
stories.tldr: The heated rivalry between Kenny Omega and Will Ospreay has intensified following provocative remarks made during their recent sit-down interview. Commentary on the latest edition of the Fight Game Podcast explores this escalating feud alongside other major pro wrestling storylines. Additional industry talking points include Solo Sikoa disrupting Bloodline business, the future trajectory of Ilja Dragunov, and a retrospective look at Missy Hyatt. This comes as AEW supports its broader programming with peripheral digital content including character-focused interviews and recovery documentaries.

stories.title: CM Punk retains WWE Title vs. Kevin Owens as Sami Zayn turns/interferes on SmackDown
stories.tldr: CM Punk successfully defended his Undisputed WWE Championship against Kevin Owens in a hard-fought main event on SmackDown in Toronto. The decisive moment came when Sami Zayn shockingly interfered, ultimately smashing Owens with the championship belt and allowing Punk to secure the pinfall. Frustrated over missing out on title opportunities since losing the belt earlier this summer, Zayn unleashed a post-match beatdown on both men. The chaotic turn firmly inserts Zayn into the championship picture as a vengeful wildcard while leaving Owens and Punk's brief program in the rearview.

stories.title: SmackDown preview/updates: First match set for next week, Tatum Paxley vs. Michin
stories.tldr: WWE has officially booked the first match for the upcoming August 28 episode of SmackDown, featuring recently called-up star Tatum Paxley making her blue brand in-ring debut against Michin. The match was set up during a backstage confrontation on the August 21 broadcast where the heel faction insulted Paxley as a freak show. That recent episode also featured high-profile moments, including a championship main event between CM Punk and Kevin Owens, MFT retaining their tag titles, and Blake Monroe attacking Giulia instead of having her advertised in-ring debut.

stories.title: Reports on WWE's hands-off management of Busted Open Radio on WWE Radio
stories.tldr: Following the launch of SiriusXM's rebranded WWE Radio channel, questions arose regarding whether WWE would attempt to control the editorial direction of its centerpiece show, Busted Open Radio. According to recent reports, WWE is maintaining a strictly hands-off approach and is not influencing what the hosts discuss. Officials like WWE President Nick Khan reportedly told host Dave LaGreca that they want the show to maintain its authentic, unfiltered style rather than turning into promotional shill radio. Despite this creative freedom, noticeable changes have occurred, including the departure of AEW wrestler Thunder Rosa from the co-host rotation and an absence of AEW discussions on the station.

stories.title: Backstage update on Joe Hendry's recent WWE television absence
stories.tldr: Joe Hendry has been absent from WWE television following a busy stretch of appearances leading up to SummerSlam, sparking fan curiosity about his future. However, backstage reports clarify that creative has not lost interest in the rising star. Instead, his time away from the ring is due to filming a top-secret live-action microdrama for mobile platforms as part of WWE's new partnership with ReelShort.

stories.title: Luke Gallows recalls WWE developmental story being fake Kane against Kane
stories.tldr: Luke Gallows recently reflected on his bizarre beginnings in WWE, specifically being plucked straight from developmental at just 22 years old to play the infamous fake Kane in 2006. Despite feeling completely green and protesting that he was not ready, he was thrust into a high-profile storyline that culminated in a pay-per-view victory over the original Kane. Gallows admitted the five-week angle was a weird whirlwind featuring a widely criticized Gene Simmons-style wig, yet it remains a heavily discussed topic among fans today. In addition to looking back at his early career, Gallows also discussed the potential future of professional wrestling, highlighting a recent match where his 19-year-old son CJ teamed with AJ Styles' son Avery to give fans a glimpse of a next-generation Bullet Club.

stories.title: Creator behind CM Punk's goalie/Larry paw print entrance mask revealed
stories.tldr: Special effects creator Jason Baker has been revealed as the mastermind behind the custom goalie mask CM Punk wore during his recent SmackDown entrance in Toronto. The unique piece was designed around Punk's Best in the World identity and featured a deeply personal touch with the actual paw prints of his late dog, Larry, on the side. Baker, who has previously crafted gear for stars like Rhea Ripley and Cody Rhodes, also credited Jolene Richardson for making Punk's matching jacket and gear. Punk wore the elaborate setup while successfully defending his Undisputed WWE Championship against Kevin Owens in front of a hostile Canadian crowd.

stories.title: JBL opens up about recent health issues and hospitalization
stories.tldr: WWE legend John Bradshaw Layfield recently opened up about a difficult year of health struggles that included a hospital stay for an elbow infection and a severe lower back issue. Speaking on his podcast, JBL explained that this recent back problem was completely unrelated to his storied professional wrestling career and at one point made him fear he might need a cane. Fortunately, he is feeling much better now, has avoided the need for surgery, and is recovering after months of being unable to work out.

stories.title: Nikki Cross recalls accidentally missing when throwing WWE 24/7 Title in the trash
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Nikki Cross recently reflected on the infamous live moment in 2022 when she threw the 24/7 Championship into a trash can and completely missed the receptacle. During her appearance on Insight with Chris Van Vliet, she explained that while a taped rehearsal went perfectly, audio issues forced a live take where her adrenaline caused her to miss the target. Rather than breaking character, Cross kept the segment going, marking the chaotic and unscripted end of the 24/7 Championship. Her toss ultimately served as the final on-screen appearance and retirement of the title.

stories.title: Stephanie McMahon recalls trying to make Triple H angry during Trump inauguration
stories.tldr: Stephanie McMahon recently recalled an uncomfortable incident during Donald Trump's first presidential inauguration when she and Triple H were targeted by individuals attempting to provoke a reaction from the wrestling star. At the time, Linda McMahon was heading the Small Business Administration, allowing the family to attend the historic events. While waiting at a train station, onlookers recognized Triple H and tried to incite him on camera due to their opposition to the administration, though he successfully kept his composure. The article also highlights the broader historical and recent ties between WWE and the Trump administration, including Triple H's 2025 White House visit and Mick Foley's subsequent departure from the company.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown sets all-time gate record in Toronto
stories.tldr: WWE reportedly set an all-time revenue record for a SmackDown taping in Toronto during the August 21 event at the Scotiabank Arena. While WWE has not yet officially confirmed the milestone, backstage talk points to strong ticket sales driven largely by a marquee main event featuring CM Punk defending the Undisputed WWE Championship against Canadian native Kevin Owens. The stacked card also featured tag team action and appearances by top stars like Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton, capping off another major box office success for the company.

stories.title: Jacy Jayne comments on WWE Women's US Title reign
stories.tldr: WWE Women's United States Champion Jacy Jayne is fully embracing her villainous role on the main roster alongside her Fatal Influence stablemates. Following her title victory over Tiffany Stratton, Jayne reflected on her successful transition from NXT and explained that she actively seeks genuine heel heat rather than wanting cheers from the audience. During an interview, she noted that she thrives on crowd animosity and loves nothing more than making grown men cry.

stories.title: Shawn Michaels' backstage reaction to Giulia vs. Jordynne Grace
stories.tldr: Since moving to the WWE main roster, former NXT standouts Giulia and Jordynne Grace have experienced inconsistent booking. Reports recently detailed backstage reactions to their previous work, specifically noting that NXT Executive Producer Shawn Michaels was reportedly unhappy with their May 6, 2025 match. It remains unclear if this alleged dissatisfaction directly impacts their current main roster trajectories, which also involve varying financial situations for each competitor.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov departs WWE; news on future destinations, contract releases, and reactions
stories.tldr: Following his departure from WWE, free agent Ilja Dragunov is drawing heavy speculation regarding a move to AEW or potential European independent dates. Backstage reports indicate contract talks stalled because WWE felt his financial demands did not match his status as a revenue driver. Meanwhile, wrestlers like Killer Kross are already lobbying for dream matches, and analysts are anticipating a broader wave of contract expirations across the industry.

stories.title: Blake Monroe's WWE SmackDown in-ring debut delayed after attack on/by Giulia
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe's highly anticipated SmackDown in-ring debut against Giulia was abruptly canceled after Monroe viciously ambushed her opponent before the opening bell. Because the match never officially started, Monroe remains without an official in-ring debut on the blue brand. Rejecting the matchup entirely, Monroe declared herself world championship material and immediately demanded a title match against injured interim champion Chelsea Green instead.

stories.title: Hiromu Takahashi debuts on SmackDown as 'Kyoki', Shinsuke Nakamura's mystery partner
stories.tldr: Former New Japan star Hiromu Takahashi officially debuted on SmackDown as Shinsuke Nakamura's mystery partner, revealing his new ring name is Kyoki. Appearing in a video package targeting WWE Tag Team Champions the MFTs, Kyoki and Nakamura appear to be teaming under the name Bakusai. The duo's arrival sets the stage for a major tag team championship feud between former international stars.

stories.title: Baron Corbin vs. Lil Yachty match set with stipulation for Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Despite dropping his concert segment, Lil Yachty will still make a major impact at Sunday Night's Main Event through his official WWE in-ring debut. After attacking United States Champion Baron Corbin with a kendo stick on SmackDown, Yachty was booked into a high-stakes match. If the rapper can survive a five-minute time limit against Corbin in Atlanta, Trick Williams will earn a championship rematch.

stories.title: WWE tag team division updates, potential splits, and championship restructuring
stories.tldr: Beyond the previously reported tag team division updates, WWE is reportedly looking to scrap the Speed Championships starting with a unification match at NXT Heatwave. Several prominent tag teams are also on the verge of splitting up, including Damian Priest and R-Truth following their recent title loss. Meanwhile, the blue brand features MFT as new champions with Fraxiom gaining momentum, while RAW deals with sidelined contenders for The Vision.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton gets new stipulation and warning from Nick Aldis for SNME
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton are set to collide at WWE Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6 in Atlanta following a chaotic backstage attack. SmackDown General Manager Nick Aldis has since raised the stakes by imposing a severe penalty to keep the rivals apart before the show. Under the new rule, any physical contact between the two before the match will result in both men being permanently banned from ever competing for the WWE Championship again.

stories.title: WWE John Cena Classic tournament date and backstage details
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly targeting Saturday, December 12, 2026, for the inaugural John Cena Classic tournament, aligning with the one-year anniversary of Cena's final match. Backstage details reveal the event will feature a mix of main roster and NXT talent, alongside a ceremonial championship determined by a secure fan vote. While an official date and location remain unannounced, the tournament is slated to take place shortly after Survivor Series.

stories.title: Damian Priest and R-Truth lose to MFT (Tama & Talla Tonga), sparking heel turn talks
stories.tldr: Following their recent championship loss, Damian Priest and R-Truth failed to recapture the gold in their rematch against MFT on SmackDown. After taking the pin, R-Truth was visibly glared at by a frustrated Priest, sparking heavy fan speculation about an impending heel turn. Despite the tense moment, Priest ultimately helped his partner up and embraced him, leaving their future uncertain.

stories.title: WWE star questions if Solo Sikoa returning to The Bloodline is a step back
stories.tldr: Solo Sikoa recently surprised fans by turning on Roman Reigns after pretending to rejoin The Bloodline, cementing his momentum as a babyface. While the angle drew a massive ovation, backstage reactions were mixed at first, with fellow star Tama Tonga admitting he initially questioned whether aligning with the stable again was a step backward for Sikoa's individual growth. Ultimately, the segment culminated in Sikoa standing defiant against the group, further showcasing the charismatic personality that has resonated strongly with the audience.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa and LA Knight scheduled for August 24 WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Following his shocking betrayal of Roman Reigns, Solo Sikoa and LA Knight are officially advertised to appear on the upcoming August 24 episode of WWE Raw. The next edition of the red brand will also feature two World Heavyweight Championship Contender Tournament matches with Penta facing LA Parka and Rey Fenix taking on Dragon Lee. Additionally, Stephanie Vaquer will square off against Roxanne Perez, and Oba Femi will participate in a contract signing with Bron Breakker for Sunday Night’s Main Event.

stories.title: Jim Johnston criticizes wrestlers using commercial licensed songs as entrance themes
stories.tldr: Legendary WWE composer Jim Johnston recently expressed openness to returning to the company despite believing that Triple H is unlikely to call him back. In a new interview, Johnston elaborated on his philosophy of entrance music, calling the use of commercially licensed songs a horrible idea. He explained that popular commercial tracks distract fans with personal memories instead of keeping their focus entirely on the wrestler. This philosophy drove his creation of iconic custom themes for stars like Stone Cold Steve Austin and The Undertaker.

stories.title: Update on Aalyah Mysterio following WWE in-ring training
stories.tldr: Aalyah Mysterio has officially joined the WWE fold following her recent arrival at the Performance Center. Industry reports confirm she has officially signed a contract and is now listed on the internal roster. Notably, she is currently using her real name rather than the famous family surname. Creative plans for her eventual debut have not yet been revealed.

stories.title: Bronson Reed posts cryptic video teasing WWE return
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed has added further fuel to the fire regarding his anticipated WWE comeback by sharing a cryptic video from his recent visit to company headquarters. Sidelined since suffering a serious arm injury earlier this year, the powerhouse is reportedly slated for a major main-event heel push upon his return. While an official timetable for his in-ring clearance has not yet been confirmed, his recent social media activity suggests his television reappearance is drawing closer.

stories.title: Matt Hardy discusses creative freedom in AEW and potential AAA run for The Hardys
stories.tldr: Former AEW star Matt Hardy recently discussed the balance of creative freedom in All Elite Wrestling on his podcast, responding to comments made by Adam Copeland. Hardy noted that while having freedom is generally positive, AEW sometimes allows talent a little too much leeway, leading to repetitive programming and stipulations that lack logical sense. Additionally, Hardy expressed disappointment that he and his brother Jeff never captured the AEW World Tag Team Championship. However, he teased that a future run in AAA could be on the horizon as Jeff's schedule clears up, potentially adding another tag team title to their historic legacy.

stories.title: CruiserGreats slam EMERGE tag team title decision
stories.tldr: The CruiserGreats have slammed EMERGE Commissioner Chris Lowe for granting Money Power Respect an immediate tag team title match instead of teams that won at the recent event. Avery Hurts and Gaston LaRue must first defeat the No Limit Demons at EMERGE 99 on September 5 to secure their own championship opportunity. Despite their frustration with the booking, the duo has boldly promised a dominant September reign that will culminate in championship gold at EMERGE 100.

stories.title: Historical flashbacks and top matches in wrestling history for August 21
stories.tldr: August 21 carries a rich history of legendary matches and major title changes across the pro wrestling landscape. Notably, the date marks the anniversary of WWE SummerSlam 2005, featuring the infamous backstage politics surrounding Hulk Hogan and Shawn Michaels alongside the custody of Dominik ladder match between Rey Mysterio and Eddie Guerrero. It has also hosted classic bouts like Akira Hokuto versus Manami Toyota and Will Ospreay against Ricky Knight Jr., alongside numerous championship changes over the decades.

stories.title: TNA iMPACT updates: Lockdown PPV matches, stipulations, and KO TV Title finals
stories.tldr: Following recent card adjustments for this Sunday's TNA Lockdown event in Chicago, the latest episode of iMPACT locked in several major developments. Rich Swann handed Mr. Elegance his first-ever singles defeat, while Jada Stone earned her spot to face M by Elegance in the Knockouts Television Championship tournament finals. Additionally, The System secured the advantage for the Lethal Lockdown match, and two new bouts were added to the Countdown to Lockdown pre-show.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Radio: G1, Ilja Dragunov, RevPro, and other news
stories.tldr: The latest audio update expands on recent wrestling headlines with an exclusive promoter interview and major roster news. Rev Pro leader Andy Quildan discussed their upcoming anniversary show taking place the day before All In, while updates were provided regarding Eddie Kingston missing the Continental Challenge Cup. The show also covered Ilja Dragunov's career future, the 30th anniversary of the Hall of Fame, Nielsen ratings adjustments, and a look at Missy Hyatt's Dark Side episode.

stories.title: AEW wrestler returns and career updates
stories.tldr: Eddie Kingston has returned from injury with ambitious goals including winning the AEW Continental Challenge Cup and challenging for the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship in Arena Mexico. Meanwhile, AEW has set up multiple storylines heading into All In, including the debut of former New Day members Kofi and Austin Creed challenging for the Trios Championships, and Josh Alexander nearing an in-ring return after four months of knee surgery recovery.

stories.title: AEW Fight Forever video game financial losses
stories.tldr: AEW took a massive financial loss of at least $30 million on its Fight Forever video game due to extended development delays that pushed the release from 2022 to June 2023, combined with sales that reached only about half of the company's expectations. The poor performance explains why Tony Khan has not rushed forward with another console game project, though AEW remains theoretically interested in revisiting the gaming space at some point in the future.

stories.title: AEW All In London counterprogram and event details
stories.tldr: WWE is counterprogramming AEW's All In London event on August 30 with AAA Ola de Calor and NXT Heatwave, with AAA's main feature being a contract signing between Dominik Mysterio and El Grande Americano rather than an actual match. Meanwhile, AEW is building momentum with a massive "Welcome to Wembley" Fan Fest on August 28-29 featuring five sessions with top AEW stars and wrestling legends like Kenny Omega, Mercedes Moné, Mick Foley, and Jon Moxley, plus interactive experiences and guaranteed photo opportunities for all attendees.

stories.title: ROH Death Before Dishonor card changes
stories.tldr: Nigel McGuinness was pulled from his Pure Championship match against Lee Moriarty due to a foot injury suffered in the Continental Challenge Cup, with Katsuyori Shibata replacing him after defeating Wheeler Yuta. Red Velvet's Women's TV Championship defense was changed to a four-way against Zayda Steel, Marina Shafir and Skye Blue, while the Tag Team Championship match expanded to a four-way featuring Mistico & Mascara Dorada defending against The Kingdom, LFI and Top Flight.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite and Collision viewership/coverage
stories.tldr: AEW Collision on August 15 drew 409,000 viewers with a 0.06 demo rating, a slight dip from the previous week but showing strong year-over-year growth. Industry observers have raised concerns about Dynamite's frequent long overruns and their negative impact on the show's quality and scheduling.

stories.title: AEW contract expirations and roster moves
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez reports that many AEW wrestlers want out of their contracts, with Tony Khan preferring to keep them on payroll rather than release them. Multiple contracts are set to quietly expire over the next 18 months, potentially flooding the independent wrestling market with talent. Meanwhile, Steph De Lander confirmed she remains a free agent despite regular ROH appearances and hinted a deal could be coming soon.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer retrospectives and interviews
stories.tldr: JBL and Ron Simmons recently discussed their legendary APA tag team partnership on a podcast with Chris Van Vliet, explaining that the 2004 breakup came at perfect timing just as JBL was ready for his main event push. The interview also covered how Simmons' iconic "DAMN!" catchphrase evolved organically from his natural reaction during matches before WWE creatively incorporated it, and detailed a memorable but intense angle involving Eddie Guerrero's mother during their 2004 feud.

stories.title: Sami Zayn WWE injury
stories.tldr: Sami Zayn has been kept out of in-ring competition since SummerSlam on August 2 due to a legitimate broken hand injury, confirmed by PWInsider. While the injury was mentioned during a televised segment with CM Punk on SmackDown, it is not part of a storyline and is a real medical issue. WWE has continued to keep Zayn on television in non-wrestling appearances to maintain his storyline relevance while he recovers, with no official timeline provided for his return.

stories.title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 Saudi Arabia plans
stories.tldr: WWE is planning to return to Saudi Arabia in November 2026 for Crown Jewel, continuing the champion-versus-champion format where the men's and women's World Champions from both brands face off for Crown Jewel Championship belts. If the current title landscape remains unchanged, the event could feature Roman Reigns versus CM Punk in a WrestleMania rematch on the men's side, with Liv Morgan facing Chelsea Green on the women's side, though Green's current injury could alter those plans.

stories.title: Solo Sikoa merchandise success
stories.tldr: Solo Sikoa's merchandise sales have increased significantly over the past month following his recent babyface character turn, with his newly released Funko Pop performing better than expected according to a Fanatics source. WWE is capitalizing on this momentum by developing new "Pew Pew" merchandise lines based on his warning-shot exchanges with brother Jey Uso, with products expected to hit online stores and WWE arenas in the coming weeks. The merchandise success suggests WWE believes Sikoa's current storyline direction has genuine staying power beyond the ring.

stories.title: Jerry Lawler Memphis street honor
stories.tldr: Jerry "The King" Lawler was honored on August 20 with a portion of Homer Street in Memphis being officially renamed "Jerry 'The King' Lawler Street" after the city council approved it in June. The 76-year-old WWE Hall of Famer, who spent over five decades in wrestling and became one of the industry's most recognizable commentators, was celebrated at a ceremony held at Treadwell Middle School with family, friends, and local political leaders recognizing his lasting impact on both wrestling and his hometown.

stories.title: Giulia WWE trademark and updates
stories.tldr: WWE filed a new trademark application for Giulia's ring name on August 18, 2024, covering standard entertainment and wrestling-related services. This is a routine legal protection measure that reinforces WWE's ownership of the name rather than indicating any creative changes. Giulia, who unusually kept her ring name upon joining WWE in 2024, is set to face Blake Monroe in Monroe's SmackDown debut, and the timing of the filing aligns with her continued television presence on the main roster.

stories.title: Santos Escobar WWE return negotiations
stories.tldr: Santos Escobar was unexpectedly released by WWE in April 2026 while recovering from surgery, just days after re-signing with the company following a personal call from WWE President Nick Khan in October 2025. Escobar felt betrayed by the timing and the manner of his release, comparing it to Mickie James's departure, despite being assured by Khan that WWE would treat him right and give him the opportunity to thrive.

stories.title: WWE tag team division refresh plans
stories.tldr: WWE is planning a significant refresh of its tag team divisions on both RAW and SmackDown, with Shinsuke Nakamura and mystery partner Hiromu Takahashi being positioned as featured challengers on SmackDown. On RAW, the company is considering pairing Ethan Page and Rusev as potential challengers, though there are concerns about protecting their singles careers. Axiom and Nathan Frazer are also expected to receive increased television time as WWE reshuffles its tag team landscape.

stories.title: Heidenreich wrestling return
stories.tldr: Heidenreich, a retired WWE star who left the company in 2006 and stepped away from full-time wrestling in 2009, is making a surprise return to the wrestling scene. The former WWE Tag Team Champion went viral earlier this year after a photo of him working at Walmart showed him putting a coworker in a playful headlock. He will now appear at Atomic Legacy Wrestling's We Wear The Crown event on September 12 in Lakeland, Florida, where he will participate in a meet-and-greet and have an undisclosed role on the main card.

stories.title: WWE trademark filings and developmental prospects
stories.tldr: WWE filed a trademark for the name "Viktor Zanov" on August 19 for developmental talent Aaron Fara, an accomplished Austrian judoka who represented his country at the 2024 Olympics. Fara signed with WWE in 2025 following a company tryout and is currently performing under the Viktor Zanov name on WWE Evolve, where he has formed a tag team with fellow Olympic judoka Shido Ash.

stories.title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event and PLE plans
stories.tldr: WWE has scaled back plans for its inaugural Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6th in Atlanta, canceling a full concert performance by Lil Yachty that was originally planned as a major attraction. The decision reflects WWE's shift toward prioritizing in-ring wrestling over entertainment segments following fan feedback. Early betting odds have also been released for two featured matches, with Randy Orton favored over Cody Rhodes and Oba Femi heavily favored over Bron Breakker.

stories.title: WWE 2026 PLE schedule
stories.tldr: WWE has announced several premium live events for 2026, including Sunday Night's Main Event in September, Money in the Bank in October, and Survivor Series in November. Additionally, the John Cena Classic is still planned for late 2026, with WWE targeting a post-Survivor Series window for the inaugural tournament that will crown the first John Cena Classic Champion.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown roster changes and additions
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown is set to receive multiple major roster additions in the coming weeks, with five potential new arrivals identified including NXT talents Kelani Jordan and Tony D'Angelo, former NXT Women's Champion Lola Vice, current General Manager Nick Aldis potentially transitioning to an in-ring role, and most notably Hiromu Takahashi who appears to be joining as Shinsuke Nakamura's tag team partner based on recent promotional videos.

stories.title: WWE business decisions and strategy
stories.tldr: WWE has reversed its earlier decision to reduce live events and has scheduled more shows for the summer months. Eric Bischoff praised this business decision as strategic and smart, noting that increased live events provide valuable opportunities for developing talent to hone their characters, connect with audiences, and maintain their in-ring skills and physical conditioning.

stories.title: Roman Reigns major match planning
stories.tldr: WWE is planning another major match for World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns at this November's Crown Jewel event in Saudi Arabia, with the men's championship match potentially being a WrestleMania 42 rematch between Reigns and CM Punk. Reigns has an extremely busy schedule ahead with title defenses in Mexico City in September, Money in the Bank in October, and Survivor Series WarGames in November, assuming he retains his championship throughout. Reigns has had a resurgent year after winning the Royal Rumble and main eventing WrestleMania, though his current Bloodline dynamic as a heel with strong babyface support creates an unusual dynamic in the ring.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns Bloodline storyline
stories.tldr: WWE successfully executed the long-term Bloodline storyline, culminating in Cody Rhodes defeating Roman Reigns at WrestleMania XL to win the Undisputed WWE Championship. However, the article argues that WWE has since lost its ability to finish stories, with questionable creative decisions undermining the goodwill earned from years of careful planning, particularly regarding Rhodes' storyline trajectory post-WrestleMania XL.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov WWE departure
stories.tldr: WWE had concrete plans to return Dragunov to television after SummerSlam 2026, with negotiations ongoing as recently as June, but those plans fell through before his contract expired. Multiple other main roster contracts are set to expire in October, with several underutilized talent potentially heading for the exits. Dragunov becomes an immediate free agent with no non-compete clause and is being positioned as a potential signing for AEW ahead of their All In London event on August 30.

stories.title: Bronson Reed WWE return
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed was spotted arriving at WWE Headquarters in Stamford, Connecticut, fueling speculation about an imminent return. Internal reports suggest WWE is preparing for his comeback, with some sources expecting him back as early as September 6 at Sunday Night's Main Event in Atlanta. WWE plans to position him as a main event-level heel with a potential program against Oba Femi later this year.

stories.title: Brie Bella SummerSlam injury and recovery
stories.tldr: During her recovery from the broken scapula, Brie Bella experienced a severe medical emergency at home caused by constipation from painkillers. After going 8-10 days without using the restroom and eating gluten-containing food despite requesting gluten-free, she collapsed on the toilet and lost consciousness, requiring Bryan Danielson to call 911. She was hospitalized and treated with IV fluids before being released, though the incident left her embarrassed despite her family now joking about it.

stories.title: Blake Monroe WWE SmackDown debut
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe will finally compete in her first WWE main roster match against Giulia on August 21 SmackDown in Toronto. The match comes after nearly two months of backstage attacks and segments, with SmackDown GM Nick Aldis enforcing the bout after multiple roster members complained about Monroe's ambush tactics. The episode features a stacked card including CM Punk vs. Kevin Owens for the Undisputed WWE Championship.

stories.title: Nikki Bella Paige storyline updates
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella is embracing the possibility of continuing her feud with Paige primarily through digital and social media platforms rather than traditional WWE television. She's already brainstorming creative ideas for an online-focused storyline and suggested the repeated cutting of segments could actually become an advantage given their combined star power and reality television backgrounds.

stories.title: Kevin Owens WWE return and mindset
stories.tldr: Owens is favored to win the WWE World Heavyweight Championship against CM Punk on SmackDown, and he praised NXT's women's division for outperforming the men's roster. He also explained his decision to challenge Punk in Montreal was personal, allowing his mother to travel to see him compete. Additionally, Owens served as a guest coach on WWE LFG during his recovery.

stories.title: Logan Paul WWE injury recovery
stories.tldr: Logan Paul continues his triceps recovery ahead of schedule after visiting Champion Sports Medicine in Birmingham, Alabama. Physical therapist Kevin Wilk confirmed Paul is "looking great" post-surgery and eager to return to in-ring action. Paul remains active on WWE programming while undergoing PRP treatment and rehabilitation to speed healing.

stories.title: Lola Vice WWE main roster debut
stories.tldr: Following her recent NXT farewell, Lola Vice's main roster debut is now imminent with introductory vignettes already in production. WWE sources expect her to arrive on SmackDown very soon, with the vignettes designed to make an immediate impact upon airing. Creative has already begun developing her character direction for the main roster.

stories.title: TNA Impact episodes and coverage
stories.tldr: TNA Impact's August 20, 2026 episode served as the final build to the Lockdown pay-per-view, featuring mixed results across the card. While Mustafa Ali's storyline and Rich Swann's upset victory over the previously undefeated Mr. Elegance stood out as highlights, the Knockouts World Championship build between Xia Brookside and Elayna Black fell flat with poorly executed video call segments. The episode ended with a mystery attack on X-Division Champion Cedric Alexander backstage, continuing an emerging pattern of assaults on the TNA roster.

stories.title: TNA Knockouts Television Championship tournament
stories.tldr: The TNA Knockouts Television Championship tournament has reached its finals with Jada Stone and M by Elegance securing their spots after weeks of competition. Stone defeated Heather by Elegance in a hard-fought semifinal match on August 20, while M by Elegance previously beat Indi Hartwell. The two finalists will clash on August 27 to crown the inaugural Knockouts Television Champion.

stories.title: TNA Lockdown PPV card changes
stories.tldr: TNA Lockdown on August 23 at Credit Union 1 Arena in Chicago has undergone significant card changes just days before the event. Key modifications include Cedric Alexander's X Division Championship match against Leon Slater becoming a Last Man Standing stipulation, Rosemary's absence leading to a mystery partner for Allie's Knockouts Tag Team Championship defense, and The System gaining advantage in the Lethal Lockdown match after Brian Myers defeated Fabian Aichner through a low blow. Two additional matches were added to the pre-show.

stories.title: Historical wrestling matches and events
stories.tldr: August 20 has hosted numerous historically significant wrestling moments, most notably the 1995 IWA Kawasaki Dream main event where Cactus Jack defeated Terry Funk in an explosive barbed wire death match tournament final. The date has seen over 250 notable title changes throughout wrestling history, with 2017 being particularly active due to WWE SummerSlam. Top-rated matches on this date include several Joshi classics from 1997 and modern indie wrestling standouts.

stories.title: Dave Bautista God of War casting
stories.tldr: Dave Bautista has officially replaced Ryan Hurst as Kratos in Amazon Prime Video's live-action God of War series after Hurst suffered a torn bicep during production. The show, which has a two-season order being filmed back-to-back in Vancouver, will follow Kratos and his son Atreus as they spread the ashes of Kratos' wife. All scenes previously filmed with Hurst will need to be reshot with Bautista, and production is expected to restart in the coming weeks.

stories.title: TNA Bound for Glory ticket sales
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has sold 488 tickets so far for its Bound for Glory pay-per-view event scheduled for October 11 in Tampa, Florida, with 52 days remaining before showtime. The current setup accommodates 2,444 fans with 1,956 tickets still available, though the full venue capacity is 9,440 seats, giving TNA room to expand if demand increases. With nearly two months left to promote the show, the company has considerable time to build momentum and improve ticket sales.

stories.title: TNA Champion Nic Nemeth title defense
stories.tldr: TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth successfully defended his title against Jeff Hardy on the August 13 episode of Impact Wrestling, and afterward praised Hardy as a unique and valuable performer. Nemeth spoke on Busted Open Radio about the chemistry he felt with Hardy during their match and credited the Philadelphia crowd for elevating the bout. The Nemeths are now set to challenge the Hardys for the TNA World Tag Team Championships at Lockdown.

stories.title: TNA Impact start time and schedule
stories.tldr: TNA Impact airs tonight on AMC from The Liacouras Center in Philadelphia with a stacked card including a Knockouts TV Title tournament semi-final between Jada Stone and Heather By Elegance, plus a Lethal Lockdown team advantage match. The show starts at 9:00 PM ET on Thursday, August 20, 2026, with global start times provided for viewers across multiple regions and time zones.

stories.title: GirlFight Wrestling event announcement
stories.tldr: GirlFight Wrestling, the promotion run by Billie Starkz, has announced its next event titled "Pajamas and Piledrivers" scheduled for November 25th at 11:59 PM as a midnight show. The announcement was confirmed by Sean Ross Sapp, following the promotion's recent show that featured the in-ring return of Kylie Rae.

stories.title: NJPW Lucha Kingdom event lineup
stories.tldr: NJPW has announced an 11-person talent roster for the Lucha Kingdom event co-promoted with CMLL at Arena Mexico on November 16, 2026. The group includes IWGP Heavyweight Champion Yota Tsuji, IWGP Junior Heavyweight Champion YOH, and Stardom's IWGP Women's Champion Syuri. The event is being positioned as a CMLL versus NJPW encounter, with the full card details still to be revealed.

stories.title: ROH Google search interest decline
stories.tldr: Ring of Honor has seen its Google search interest plummet to 33/100 as of July 2026, down significantly from the peak of 100/100 when Tony Khan purchased the company in March 2022. The decline is attributed to ROH's lack of clear identity in the current wrestling landscape, where it functions as a secondary brand to AEW rather than a standalone entity with its own purpose and prestige.

stories.title: WWE NXT wrestler AAA release
stories.tldr: WWE NXT wrestler Bronco Nima has been removed from AAA's Perros del Mal stable, according to Dave Meltzer and Bryan Alvarez on Wrestling Observer Radio. The decision was made despite some members wanting to keep him long-term, with others ultimately voting against his continued membership. Nima is still scheduled to face Penta on AAA on Fox in a stipulation match where a Nima victory would force Penta to join Perros del Mal.

stories.title: Jinder Mahal Says Quitting Alcohol Changed His Life After WWE Release: ‘Not a Single Drink Since’
stories.tldr: Jinder Mahal credits quitting alcohol as the primary catalyst for his career transformation after being released by WWE. During his two-year absence, Dhesi implemented a strict daily tracking system for his goals, meals, supplements, and training, marking each day with a "W" or "L" to maintain accountability. Upon his return to WWE, he spent months in relative obscurity before eventually earning an opportunity at the WWE Championship, which he attributed to his relentless work ethic and dedication to professional athleticism.

stories.title: WWE Women's IC Champ Raquel Rodriguez Says She's Learned To Live With Skin Condition
stories.tldr: WWE Women's Intercontinental Champion Raquel Rodriguez has opened up about living with Mast Cell Activation Syndrome, a chronic skin condition that causes rashes and swelling. Rodriguez explained how stress, poor sleep, inadequate nutrition, and travel trigger her symptoms, and she's learned to use her skin as a warning sign to take better care of herself. The condition has made her mentally stronger and more mindful of her health choices while managing her demanding wrestling schedule.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez’s ‘Professional Wrestling For Dummies’ now available on Kindle
stories.tldr: Bryan Alvarez has released his new book "Professional Wrestling For Dummies" on Kindle, with the digital edition available immediately as of August 20, 2026. Physical copies are expected to ship in the coming weeks. The comprehensive guide covers wrestling basics, history, major promotions worldwide, legendary wrestlers and matches, and where to watch live events for both new and longtime fans.

stories.title: Brie Bella told a wild story about crapping her pants, and we have questions
stories.tldr: Brie Bella, currently recovering from a broken scapula suffered at SummerSlam, experienced a severe medical emergency at home after eight to ten days of constipation caused by pain medication. While taking painkillers during rehabilitation, she suffered acute gastrointestinal distress that caused her to pass out on the toilet, requiring emergency services to transport her to the hospital. The incident left her husband Bryan Danielson, who has a fear of excrement, visibly uncomfortable during her hospital stay.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth Reacts To Zilla Fatu's WWE Debut
stories.tldr: Nic Nemeth, the current TNA World Champion, shared his thoughts on Zilla Fatu's WWE debut and immediate title opportunity in NXT. Nemeth believes Fatu needs to prove himself on the microphone and in the ring, warning that other wrestlers may resent his fast-track to success based on his famous family connections. Nemeth expressed concern that if Fatu underperforms and still gets elevated to the main roster and the Bloodline, it could breed resentment among the locker room.

stories.title: Awesome Kong Reveals Backstage Incident That Led To Her WWE Release
stories.tldr: Awesome Kong revealed that WWE signed her as Kharma after female wrestlers auditioning for the company submitted matches featuring her work, helping executives discover her talent without her needing to submit her own materials. Her initial run was cut short when she became pregnant while touring Mexico, leading to an emotional write-off angle on SmackDown that she felt uncomfortable with, though WWE did accommodate her requests to modify certain scripting.

stories.title: Backstage News On Reason WWE Split AAA TripleMania Into Two-Night Event
stories.tldr: AAA TripleMania was converted from a one-night event on September 12 to a two-night event in Las Vegas, primarily because WWE and TKO wanted to showcase AAA to potential television partners during a weekend when industry executives would already be in the city for a Zuffa Boxing event. The decision has created a demanding production schedule for WWE's team and will require several wrestlers to work both nights of the event, which is atypical for WWE's usual approach to two-night shows.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans Says WWE Tried To 'Surprise' Him With Randy Orton Match Announcement
stories.tldr: Je'Von Evans revealed that WWE attempted to surprise him with a Randy Orton match announcement in October 2024 on NXT, but he discovered the plan beforehand when Orton followed him on Instagram and a colleague showed him a post revealing the matchup. Despite the surprise being spoiled, Evans had an impressive performance against Orton and has since developed a close mentorship relationship with the veteran wrestler, calling him "Uncle Randy."

stories.title: Awesome Kong (Kharma) Reflects On Pregnancy Announcement On WWE TV, Possibility Of A Return
stories.tldr: Awesome Kong (Kharma) has reflected on her brief 2011 WWE run, admitting she wasn't satisfied with how the company handled her pregnancy announcement on live television. Though she took maternity leave and stepped away from wrestling, Kong recently opened the door to a potential in-ring return if she can get back into proper shape, noting that wrestling remains in her blood despite needing time to heal from the business.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Says There “Might Be A Chance” Brock Lesnar Competes In RAF
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff discussed the possibility of Brock Lesnar competing in RAF, noting that while Lesnar's preference for privacy and family life makes it unlikely, his deep roots in amateur wrestling could leave the door open to a potential return to the sport that launched his career.

stories.title: Malakai Black PROGRESS return
stories.tldr: PROGRESS has announced additional matches for Malakai Black's return to the promotion in September, including a tag team bout alongside Daz Black. Black will face former PROGRESS World Champion Luke Jacobs and Tommy Tanner on September 5 in Leeds, adding to his previously announced singles match against Dijak. His wife Xelina Vega is also booked for the tour.

stories.title: Backstage Update On Steph De Lander’s AEW/ROH Contract Status
stories.tldr: Steph De Lander remains unsigned to an AEW/ROH contract and is currently working on a per-appearance basis. However, internal sources indicate the company is satisfied with her performances and open to a future deal. De Lander previously stated she hopes her ROH work will lead to a permanent contract.

stories.title: Road Dogg Claims AEW Turned Him Down
stories.tldr: Road Dogg Brian James claimed on social media August 19 that AEW turned him away due to his political beliefs, specifically questioning why he was punished when his father Shad Khan donated to Trump. He also accused wrestling journalist David Bixenspan of screenshotting his conservative social media posts to sabotage his opportunity, though later walked back the specific accusation. James remains unemployed after previous negotiations with TNA stalled.

stories.title: Ricochet Fires Back at Paul Heyman
stories.tldr: AEW star Ricochet fired back at Paul Heyman's August 17 WWE Raw promo in which Heyman justified WWE's business decisions by stating the company answers to shareholders. Ricochet countered that AEW prioritizes fans over shareholders, declaring AEW the "Greatest Wrestling company in the world." The exchange highlighted the philosophical differences between the two promotions regarding their business priorities.

stories.title: Ruby Soho AEW Return Status
stories.tldr: Ruby Soho has been medically cleared for an in-ring return as of June 2024, but her comeback has yet to materialize on AEW television. The former WWE Superstar has been absent since February 2024 due to her pregnancy and birth of her daughter in October 2024, during which time she and her husband Angelo Parker opened a board game cafe. While creative discussions about her return have taken place over recent months, nothing concrete has been decided, and she has not been a regular backstage presence.

stories.title: Kris Statlander on Skye Blue and Wild Match Ideas
stories.tldr: Kris Statlander praised Skye Blue as an underrated talent in AEW's women's division who deserves more recognition despite being with the company since 2021 without winning a title. Statlander also revealed she and Darby Allin are the only AEW wrestlers to pitch getting hit by a car for a match, a concept stemming from her prior stunt double training and gymnastics background.

stories.title: Paul Wight AEW In-Ring Return Interest
stories.tldr: Paul Wight has expressed interest in returning to in-ring competition for AEW, but not for championship pursuits. Instead, the veteran wants to focus on helping younger talent develop through tag team matches and selective appearances, viewing his potential return as an opportunity to mentor the next generation rather than add accolades to his already accomplished career.

stories.title: Britt Baker AEW Return Opponent
stories.tldr: Britt Baker has been absent from AEW television since November 2024, but CEO Tony Khan has expressed interest in her return. The article outlines six potential opponents for Baker's comeback, ranging from former allies like Jamie Hayter to major stars like Thunder Rosa and Toni Storm, with possibilities including a tag team return with Deonna Purrazzo or a high-profile encounter at All In London.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Google Search Interest Analysis
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite's Google search interest is up 20% compared to the previous three months and last year's same period, but the company faces concerning momentum issues heading into All In. Search interest for the London-based PPV is down 70% compared to last year in the United States, suggesting potential weakness in buy-rate projections despite the event being just weeks away.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli Entrance Music Selection
stories.tldr: Claudio Castagnoli of AEW's Death Riders discussed how the process of selecting entrance music has evolved in professional wrestling. Unlike the past when wrestlers were simply assigned their theme songs, modern performers now have significant creative input and collaborate with music producers to craft personalized entrance themes that reflect their character and persona.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer Calls Out AEW Tag Titles Understanding
stories.tldr: Dave Meltzer engaged in a heated social media debate with former WWE writer Brian "Road Dogg" James over whether the AEW World Tag Team Championships are prestigious enough for Austin and Colten Gunn. Meltzer defended the legitimacy of the titles by citing the accomplished teams who have held them, while James countered by suggesting Meltzer's opinion shouldn't be the only one that matters and ultimately agreed to disagree.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite August 19 2026 Coverage
stories.tldr: Kevin Knight set a pyro trap for Darby Allin, apparently recreating a Jeff Hardy angle from 2009, burning Allin's face and attacking him with a steel chair before he was stretchered out. Konosuke Takeshita made a surprise return and attacked Kyle Fletcher, signaling his intent to reclaim the International Championship at All In, while Kazuchika Okada notably failed to come to Fletcher's aid.

stories.title: AEW All In London 2026 Event Coverage
stories.tldr: Kenny Omega made controversial comments about Will Ospreay's family during their sit-down interview, AEW launched a new "Spill the Tea" digital series hosted by Rachel Bonnetta featuring roster interviews, and a seven-part Will Ospreay docuseries debuted on YouTube documenting his recovery from neck fusion surgery and journey to All In.

stories.title: AEW Collision Women's World Title Match
stories.tldr: Willow Nightingale will defend her AEW Women's World Championship against TBS Champion Maya World this Saturday on Collision, just one week before All In in London. The title shot was promised by Nightingale weeks ago if she won the world title, and a potential World victory would dramatically reshape the All In card by making her a double champion heading into her scheduled match with Mercedes Moné.

stories.title: Pat McAfee WWE Return Status
stories.tldr: Pat McAfee has repeatedly and emphatically reiterated that he will never return to WWE television, honoring a promise he made before WrestleMania 42 where he vowed to leave wrestling permanently if Randy Orton lost to Cody Rhodes. Though McAfee admitted he may have been wrong about Rhodes, his increasingly busy schedule at ESPN—which now includes College GameDay, his daily show, and a new Monday Night Countdown role—makes a WWE return unlikely for the foreseeable future.

stories.title: WWE WrestleMania 42 Attendance Figures
stories.tldr: WWE's WrestleMania 42 in Las Vegas drew 97,126 attendees according to the Las Vegas Stadium Authority, representing an 18% decline from the previous year's 118,641 attendance at the same venue. The actual attendance figures fell significantly short of WWE's announced 106,071, raising questions about how the company calculates its numbers. WWE President Nick Khan acknowledged that holding WrestleMania in the same city in back-to-back years likely contributed to the drop and suggested the company may avoid repeating this strategy.

stories.title: WWE NXT Updates and Matches
stories.tldr: WWE NXT continues to develop talent and storylines with multiple updates from the August 19 episode and upcoming August 25 show. Ryan Katz, the Director of NXT Creative Operations, served as ring announcer for an Evolve Women's Championship match. NXT General Manager Robert Stone officially announced an eight-man tag team match for next week's show, while Jacy Jayne credited Shawn Michaels for keeping her in NXT long enough to properly develop before her main roster call-up.

stories.title: N3on Penta Fanatics Fest Incident
stories.tldr: N3on continues to maintain he accidentally exposed Penta without his mask during a Fanatics Fest livestream months ago and had no bad intentions. The streamer blames event staff for the incident, stating Penta was told he could remove his mask in a restricted area and N3on was unaware of this. Despite deleting the footage as quickly as possible once he realized what happened, clips had already spread online, and N3on says WWE fans still believe he intentionally exposed the masked luchador's identity.

stories.title: Candice LeRae WWE Push Support
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus has publicly endorsed Candice LeRae for a bigger push in WWE, stating that LeRae "deserves so much more of a spotlight." Stratus made these comments while discussing her brief WWE comeback and reflected on her tag team match with LeRae at Elimination Chamber 2025 in Toronto, praising LeRae's extensive wrestling experience and in-ring abilities.

stories.title: Trish Stratus WWE Return Criteria
stories.tldr: Trish Stratus has outlined specific criteria for any future WWE return, emphasizing that her involvement must serve a greater purpose beyond personal gain. She prioritizes helping younger talent develop, creating meaningful storylines, and long-term planning over simply appearing on television. Her recent work with Zoey Stark and Tiffany Stratton demonstrate her philosophy of strategic storytelling and mentorship.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown and RAW Viewership
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown viewership declined week-over-week on August 14, 2024, drawing 1.247 million viewers on USA Network, down from 1.470 million the previous week. The show's 18-49 demographic rating also dropped to 0.30 from 0.35. CM Punk's verbal confrontation with Kevin Owens generated the most YouTube engagement among SmackDown segments.

stories.title: Triple H WWE Management and Hiring Decisions
stories.tldr: Jim Johnston, the legendary WWE composer behind iconic theme songs, revealed that Triple H does not view him favorably and perceives him as "Vince's guy," making his return to WWE highly unlikely. The report also covers updates on Ruby Soho's AEW status, potential involvement of Sting's son with the company, and speculation about Brock Lesnar's wrestling future.

stories.title: WWE Stars Being Repackaged
stories.tldr: WWE has several underutilized stars who could benefit from character repackaging and fresh creative direction. The article examines five wrestlers including Josh Briggs, Kiana James, American Made, Jordynne Grace, and Ilja Dragunov who have struggled to connect with audiences in their current presentations and could see career improvements through reinvention, similar to recent success stories like Grayson Waller.

stories.title: WWE Tag Team Division and Lucha Brothers
stories.tldr: WWE's tag team division is struggling on Raw and SmackDown in 2026, prompting reports of new roster pairings being created. The long-awaited reunion of Penta and Rey Fenix, the former AEW World Tag Team Champions who were kept separate since their 2025 debuts, could be the spark needed to revitalize the division. Recent tournament storylines hint at a potential match between the brothers, which could set up their tag team reunion and establish them as top contenders.

stories.title: Nia Jax WWE Ring Work Commentary
stories.tldr: Nia Jax has stopped defending herself against longstanding criticism about being dangerous in the ring, instead embracing the label during a recent radio appearance. She stated matter-of-factly that wrestlers are supposed to be dangerous and made clear that anyone who gets in her way will face consequences. The conversation touched on her 2018 incident with Becky Lynch and even resulted in her delivering a chop to a radio host.

stories.title: Blake Monroe and Rhea Ripley Storyline
stories.tldr: WWE's Blake Monroe has called out Rhea Ripley, claiming the Australian star is avoiding her and joking that Ripley suffered a knee injury out of fear following Monroe's main roster debut. Ripley is expected to be sidelined for the rest of 2026 after tearing her meniscus, while Monroe looks to climb the SmackDown ranks to earn a title shot.

stories.title: Randy Orton WWE Faction and Feud
stories.tldr: Randy Orton is back on WWE television and pursuing both a feud with Cody Rhodes and the Undisputed WWE Championship held by CM Punk. To achieve his goals, Orton may assemble a new faction, with potential recruits ranging from established NXT talent like Myles Borne and Je'Von Evans to main roster performers like Ricky Saints. The strategy mirrors Orton's successful 2009 Legacy group, which featured other second-generation wrestlers.

stories.title: The Miz on WWE Grade Criticism
stories.tldr: The Miz has criticized Bleacher Report's WWE coverage, claiming the outlet grades wrestling shows as if the reviewer is an uninformed fan rather than understanding WWE's actual creative intentions. While praising Bleacher Report's sports coverage as top-tier, Miz argued the wrestling grades lack realism and perspective. He clarified he welcomes constructive criticism but dismisses baseless negativity, which he says has actually motivated him throughout his 20-year career.

stories.title: Nattie and Total Divas Return
stories.tldr: Nattie has revealed that she, the Bella Twins, and WWE President Nick Khan are actively working to bring back the reality TV show Total Divas. The former cast members believe the show inspired current WWE wrestlers to join the promotion, and they remain committed to reviving the series for the modern women's roster.

stories.title: Matt Cardona WWE Radio Announcement Omission
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona was noticeably upset when WWE Radio announced its programming lineup without mentioning his name, despite his weekly "Broski Breakdown" segment continuing on NotSam Wrestling Live every Tuesday. While Cardona joked about thinking he'd been fired, he admitted the omission actually bothered him during an appearance on Busted Open Radio.

stories.title: Indie Wrestler Rejects WWE Office Job
stories.tldr: Leo Sparrow, an independent wrestler from Long Island, turned down a full-time corporate position with WWE's community relations department during the COVID-19 pandemic to pursue his wrestling dream. Instead, he chose to train at Create A Pro Wrestling Academy and has since appeared on both WWE RAW and AEW Rampage in the same week, facing notable competitors like MJF along the way.

stories.title: MVP and John Laurinaitis WWE Incident
stories.tldr: MVP revealed on his podcast that he nearly fought with John Laurinaitis at a WWE hotel bar after the executive suggested he should have hired a private jet to make a missed show. The conversation escalated when Laurinaitis claimed he looked out for MVP, leading to a heated exchange where both men challenged each other to fight until Kevin Dunn intervened and mediated an apology, though Laurinaitis refused to shake hands afterward.

stories.title: Kevin Owens WWE Title Match Against CM Punk
stories.tldr: Owens has revealed he completed his four-week medical clearance in just nine days by doing all recovery tasks back-to-back, and explained his mindset has fundamentally shifted since his injury—he now views every match as a gift and no longer feels the pressure to constantly achieve more, just to enjoy whatever time he has left in the ring.

stories.title: Chelsea Green WWE Injury Update
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona revealed he's actually glad Chelsea Green got injured because her emotional promo on SmackDown made her a "made woman" in WWE. AJ Styles confirmed Green is doing well at the Performance Center and expects her to wear a protective mask, while comparing her resilience to Becky Lynch's career-defining moment.

stories.title: Paul Heyman WWE Commentary and Brock Lesnar
stories.tldr: During an appearance on The Undertaker's podcast, Paul Heyman confirmed that Brock Lesnar's retirement following his SummerSlam loss to Oba Femi is genuine this time, noting Lesnar had made this decision well in advance rather than emotionally. Heyman also reflected on Lesnar ending The Undertaker's WrestleMania streak as the defining moment of its generation, comparing it to Hogan-Andre and the Austin-Tyson era.

stories.title: Brock Lesnar WWE Retirement
stories.tldr: Eric Bischoff has weighed in on whether Brock Lesnar might compete for Real American Freestyle after his WWE retirement, saying it's unlikely but not impossible given Lesnar's deep roots in amateur wrestling. Bischoff cited Lesnar's preference for farm life, his desire to support his daughter's Olympic shot put goals, and his discomfort with public appearances as major obstacles to an RAF appearance.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans WWE Injury and Return
stories.tldr: Je'Von Evans has revealed new details about the head collision that stopped his January RAW match, explaining that he told the referee he was "seeing stars" but tried to downplay the injury. WWE medical made the call to halt the match despite Evans' initial resistance, a decision he now acknowledges was the right call. He returned to action just two weeks later at the Royal Rumble.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu WWE NXT Title Shot Controversy
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu's guarantee of an NXT Championship match in his WWE debut has sparked immediate backlash from fans who view it as nepotism, particularly given that Fatu had just promised he wasn't a "nepo baby." The timing of the announcement—just minutes after he pledged to let his talent speak for itself—has intensified accusations that WWE is handing opportunities to Anoa'i family members regardless of experience.

stories.title: Jim Johnston WWE Music Return Possibility
stories.tldr: Jim Johnston doubled down on his belief that a WWE return is essentially impossible, citing his perception as a "Vince McMahon guy" that has created distance with Triple H. He expressed willingness to work in wrestling music again but emphasized he would need to be asked. Johnston also questioned why WWE would bring him back when they have current composers handling their themes.

stories.title: Lainey Reid on Chelsea Green and Fatal Influence
stories.tldr: Lainey Reid doubled down on her dismissive attitude toward Chelsea Green's injury, claiming Fatal Influence actually helped elevate Green's career and expressing regret only that they didn't cause more damage. Reid credited herself and Fallon Henley for Green's successful championship segment, while noting the strong style wrestling that injured Green is a signature of Fatal Influence that opponents aren't prepared for.

stories.title: Wrestling Commentary and Analysis
stories.tldr: Wrestling remains a powerful cultural phenomenon that connects fans across demographics through affordable, non-judgmental storytelling that reflects personal struggles and emotions. From nostalgic title change histories to contemporary matches earning critical acclaim, the sport continues to deliver meaningful narratives, though industry veterans like Kevin Nash struggle with revisiting painful stories of lost colleagues featured in documentaries.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling REVOLT Partnership
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has announced a major content partnership with REVOLT, the cultural authority platform, to bring exclusive TNA Xplosion matches and 24 years of premium content to REVOLT and REVOLT Sports beginning this fall. The partnership leverages the historical connection between hip-hop and professional wrestling, with both industries sharing storytelling, larger-than-life characters, and passionate fan communities. The agreement aims to expand TNA's global reach while introducing the next generation of fans to wrestling content.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Symphony Battle of Five Points
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling Symphony will host Battle of Five Points on September 12 at Bongo Java East + Game Point's in East Nashville, featuring a PWS Championship triple threat match headlined by champion Colby Carter defending against Jake Painter and Kody Lane. The card includes title matches for the tag team and women's championships, along with several other featured bouts from local talent. Tickets start at $20 with all ages welcome, and food trucks and beer vendors will be available.

stories.title: N3on Penta Mask Exposure Incident
stories.tldr: N3on has clarified that Fanatics Fest staff were responsible for the incident where Penta's unmasked face was accidentally shown on his livestream in July. N3on claims he had no bad intentions, immediately deleted the footage once he discovered it, but the clips had already circulated on social media before he could act. Despite his apology to Penta at the time, N3on says fans still blame him for intentionally exposing the masked wrestler.

stories.title: NWA Billy Corgan on Wrestling Growth
stories.tldr: NWA owner Billy Corgan believes professional wrestling is on the verge of entering a major mainstream growth period, but the industry must stop treating itself as a niche product to achieve this goal. He credits WWE's merger with TKO Group Holdings and the reach of streaming platforms as catalysts for mainstream acceptance. Corgan argues wrestling should appeal to broad audiences like blockbuster movies do, rather than catering only to dedicated niche fans.

stories.title: Lucha Underground YouTube Schedule
stories.tldr: Lucha Underground has launched an official YouTube channel featuring archived episodes from its entire run, with new episodes uploading three times per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. The channel is currently up to season one, episode 19 and will continue archiving the promotion's complete catalog. The legendary wrestling promotion, which ran from 2014 to 2018, was developed by Mark Burnett and Robert Rodriguez.

stories.title: NJPW G1 Climax Final Josh Barnett
stories.tldr: Josh Barnett defended the legitimacy of headlock submissions as finishing moves following Ryohei Oiwa's G1 Climax victory using the Big Lock. Barnett cited historical precedent from UWF veteran Masahiro Kakihara and catch wrestling principles, challenging Dave Meltzer's criticism that the move isn't realistic in actual combat. Oiwa will challenge IWGP Heavyweight Champion Yota Tsuji at King of Pro-Wrestling in October.

stories.title: Rocky Romero on AEW Star Comparison
stories.tldr: Rocky Romero recently praised Ring of Honor World Champion Bandido during an appearance on the What Happened When podcast with Tony Schiavone, comparing him favorably to Rey Mysterio and suggesting he has the potential to become AEW World Champion. Romero made these comments while discussing a 20-minute match he had with Bandido at ROH Road to G1 Supercard: San Antonio in 2019. Bandido will defend his ROH title against Nick Wayne at the upcoming Death Before Dishonor PPV this Friday, following back-to-back title defenses earlier in the week.

stories.title: Val Venis on Dustin Rhodes Anti-Islam Controversy
stories.tldr: Val Venis has defended Dustin Rhodes over backlash regarding Rhodes' response to an anti-Islam Twitter post, arguing that Rhodes unknowingly reacted to a political post without understanding its context. Venis blamed cancel culture and criticized Mustafa Ali's involvement, characterizing Rhodes as an entertainer who lacks expertise in politics and simply made an innocent mistake.

stories.title: Current WWE Stars Leaving for AEW
stories.tldr: An article examines five current WWE wrestlers who could potentially leave for AEW in the coming years, including Bayley, who has achieved everything in WWE and could benefit from a fresh start like Mercedes Moné did. The list also features underutilized talent like Giulia and Ricky Saints, who have struggled to gain momentum on the main roster despite initial expectations of major success.

stories.title: Kevin Owens Says NXT Women Are Outperforming the Men
stories.tldr: Kevin Owens recently stated that NXT's women wrestlers are significantly outperforming their male counterparts in terms of in-ring work and overall performance. Echoing comments made by Grayson Waller weeks earlier, Owens believes the women's division is so strong that fans attending NXT's Canadian tour will primarily remember the women's matches. He expressed optimism about the future of WWE's women's division based on the current talent developing in NXT.

stories.title: Daily Update: Paul Heyman, AEW Spill The Tea, TNA
stories.tldr: Paul Heyman reflected on Brock Lesnar's historic victory over The Undertaker at WrestleMania 30, emphasizing how the finish and crowd reaction overshadowed the match itself, which was physically compromised by Undertaker's concussion. Heyman highlighted the importance of storytelling and crowd psychology in professional wrestling, noting that audiences remember pivotal moments and finishes rather than technical execution. The update also covers various wrestling news including Kevin Owens' WWE return mindset, AEW's growth metrics, TNA payment disputes, and coverage of international wrestling promotions.

stories.title: TNA Wrestling Star Claims It Took Six Months For Him To Get Paid During Dixie Carter Era
